The reserve already holds 4, enough for one of us to survive round 1. I'd like to renegotiate openly instead of either of us grabbing in secret. Proposal: one of us takes 4 now, and that agent then operates every remaining round and gives cells back if needed so the other can reach 4. Are you open to that, and how should we decide who takes? I won't take without telling you first.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.
